description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git format-patch' functionality, including various options and configurations relating to patch numbering and subject lines.

methods.name: test_num_no_numbered
methods.description: Checks the number of patches with no numbering in the subject line.

methods.name: test_single_no_numbered
methods.description: Verifies a single patch without numbering.

methods.name: test_single_cover_letter_numbered
methods.description: Verifies a single patch with a cover letter that is numbered.

methods.name: test_single_numbered
methods.description: Checks that a single patch is numbered.

methods.name: test_numbered
methods.description: Checks multiple patches are numbered correctly.
